title: NVD - CVE-2024-0001
html:
NVD - CVE-2024-0001

Example Struts Commerce 2.5 fails to parameterise the username field of the login handler. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary rows from the customer table.

Fixed in 2.5.22. CVSS 3.1 base score 9.8 (CRITICAL).

title: NVD - CVE-2021-44228
html:
NVD - CVE-2021-44228

Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookups in log messages permit remote code execution when an attacker controls logged data. Upgrade to 2.17.1 or later.

title: Apache Log4j Vulnerability Guidance | CISA
html:
Apache Log4j Vulnerability Guidance | CISA

CISA urges organisations to identify internet-facing assets running Log4j and patch immediately. The vulnerability is being exploited in the wild by ransomware operators.

title: Resumen de Log4Shell
html:
Resumen de Log4Shell

La vulnerabilidad Log4Shell permite la ejecucion remota de codigo en aplicaciones que registran datos controlados por el atacante. Se recomienda actualizar a la version 2.17.1 y revisar los registros de las ultimas semanas para detectar intentos de explotacion.

title: Log4Shell 対応メモ
html:
Log4Shell 対応メモ

この文書は Log4Shell の影響範囲と緩和策をまとめたものです。攻撃者が制御する文字列がログに記録されると、遠隔から任意のコードが実行される可能性があります。直ちに 2.17.1 以降へ更新してください。
